summary_bullets: Anchored reviewer attribution parsing to canonical Reviewer/Reviewers lines so prose mentions no longer misattribute findings.
Included zero-finding dynamic reviewer slots in the scoreboard and defaulted missing collector status to STATUS=OK.
Updated regression harnesses and script contracts for attribution parsing, dynamic zero-finding rows, and STATUS=OK fallback.
commit_message:
fix(review): correct reviewer scoreboard attribution

Anchor reviewer attribution parsing to canonical Reviewer/Reviewers lines, include dynamic zero-finding slots in the reviewer scoreboard, and treat missing collector status as OK for slots that produced no findings.

Update vote tally and code-review tally harness coverage for the repaired cases.
